backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing a leaderboard and mission system with functions to submit/retrieve scores by game mode and add/update/query missions with progress tracking and rewards.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three implemented features (app-ads.txt serving, landing page, and game-inspired visual theme) to their associated source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and recent changes of components, hooks, and contexts in the TetrisVerse app.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point for the TetrisVerse React app, setting the page title and description for the official developer/AdMob verification site.
frontend/public/app-ads.txt: Static app-ads.txt file containing the Google AdMob publisher verification entry for TetrisVerse.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that renders only the LandingPage component, with all game-related logic removed.
frontend/src/components/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page component for the TetrisVerse developer site, displaying branding, an AdMob verification description with publisher ID, and a visible link to the app-ads.txt file.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the user's Internet Identity, handling both authenticated and anonymous access and optionally calling access control initialization methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file retained for potential future backend integrations; contains no active code.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a dark, game-inspired theme including neon color tokens, component colors, and a glow-pulse animation utility.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider (React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/types/game.ts: Empty TypeScript file intended to hold game-related type definitions.
frontend/src/types/missions.ts: Empty TypeScript file intended to hold mission-related type definitions.
frontend/src/utils/color.ts: Empty TypeScript utility file intended to hold color-related helper functions.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, persist them in sessionStorage, and clean sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that maps CSS custom properties to semantic color tokens, extends the theme with game-specific colors, custom fonts, border radii, spacing, and keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state manifest describing the TetrisVerse developer site, whose primary purpose is hosting app-ads.txt for Google AdMob verification (pub-7936595519986908) on the Internet Computer, along with existing and pending feature records.
